They Broke Me. I Own the Bank.

They saw a worn coat and decided he was powerless. They never asked who owned the bank. A quiet Black billionaire arrives to withdraw a wedding gift, only to suffer brutal abuse from employees who mistake their chairman for an easy target. At the company's handover gala, the cameras are waiting—and so is the truth. The man they humiliated steps forward, and every insult takes on a devastating new meaning. They thought they could break him. Now they must answer to the man behind the bank.
